title: Texas Standard for Sept. 23, 2026: Austin police launch independent investigation into ICE shooting
summary: Austin Police and the Travis County District Attorney’s Office are conducting their own investigation into the shooting of 28-year-old Wilber Rafael Garces Perez by an ICE officer. Newly released video...
content: Austin Police and the Travis County District Attorney’s Office are conducting their own investigation into the shooting of 28-year-old Wilber Rafael Garces Perez by an ICE officer. Newly released video shows Garces Perez had been pulled over earlier by ICE prior to the shooting. Federal authorities are conducting a separate investigation. Source
